svg.text: BHEL Traction & DCS Panel Assembly Portal — Dual-Backend System Architecture
Unified React 18 + Vite SPA backed by Cloudflare Workers (Hono + D1) in live production and Node.js 24 (Express + node:sqlite) for local/Docker deployments
Presentation Layer — Shop-Floor Web Client (client/src/)
React 18.3.1 + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS 3.4 + Lucide Icons + SheetJS (xlsx) bulk Excel/CSV import
AuthContext + api.js Bearer JWT transport (localStorage: bhel_auth_token) | ErrorBoundary | 7 color-coded navigation tabs
LoginModal -> ExecutePanels | PlanTargets | DailyStatus | Overview | ProductionReports | WhatIfSimulator | BackupMasterData
HTTPS REST /api/* (Live Cloudflare Worker Edge)
HTTP REST /api/* (Local / Container / Test Suite)
Primary Live Edge Backend — Cloudflare Workers (worker/src/)
Framework: Hono 4.6.14 + Static Assets binding (SPA + API single origin)
Routes: authRoutes, panelRoutes, planDailyRoutes, overviewReportRoutes, smbRoutes
Security: auth.js (20 req/60s rate limit, X-Frame-Options: DENY, strict CORS)
Crypto: crypto.js (Web Crypto PBKDF2-SHA256 50k iters + HS256 JWT 12h)
Services: WorkflowEngine, CapacityService, DailyStatusService, BottleneckService, SimulatorService
Health: GET /health checks D1 connectivity + runtime status
Local / Container / Node Backend — Express Server (server/src/)
Runtime: Node.js >=22.5.0 (verified on v24.19.0) + Express 4.21.2
Routes: routes/api.js + 9 domain controllers + single-port static client/dist serving
Auth & RBAC: authMiddleware.js (JWT) + permissionMiddleware.js (Area + Admin gates)
Crypto: bcryptjs (10 rounds) + jsonwebtoken (12h expiry) | CORS policy delegate
Services: Shared domain formulas parity across Workflow, Capacity, Bottleneck & Simulator
Test Suite: 7 automated Node --test files (auth, workflow, daily, capacity, backup, undo, deploy)
Cloudflare D1 Serverless SQLite (bhel-portal-db)
Managed SQLite via schema worker/migrations/0001_init.sql
10 relational tables + 13 indexes + atomic db.batch() writes
Live endpoint: https://bhel-portal.likhithb2005.workers.dev (Read-only verified)
Local / Container SQLite (node:sqlite DatabaseSync)
PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL | PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
Nested savepoints & BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions in database.js
Target file: server/data/bhel_portal.sqlite (gitignored; isolated test DB in CI)
